endpoint.span: The key secondary efficacy end point was the composite of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or stroke.

served_row_at_adjudication.endpoint_definition_span: Time to Cardiovascular Death, Myocardial Infarction, or Stroke All deaths and potential endpoint events were adjudicated by an independent external CEC led by the TIMI Study Group, using standardized definitions based on the "Standardized Definitions for Cardiovascular and Stroke End Point Events in Clinical Trials and the Third Universal Definition of Myocardial Infarction". Time to cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or stroke was defined as the time from randomization to the first occurrence of any component of the composite endpoint and was analyzed using Kaplan-Meier (KM) survival analysis. KM estimates of the percentage of participants with an event are reported. Participants with no event were censored based on last non-fatal potential endpoint collection date.
